# James Gorry

> Health and safety keynote and motivational speaker from Ireland. A former welder, steel erector and construction business owner, he fell 26 feet from a roof in Dublin in 2005 when he didn't attach his harness, and was left paraplegic. Since 2008, through James Gorry Ltd, he has spoken to construction, industrial and manufacturing companies across Ireland, the UK and Europe so every worker goes home safely.

## Talks
- Choices: the split-second decisions behind accidents
- Safety-First Mindset: equipping staff for a secure work environment
- Falls Are Preventable: working at heights
- Safety week talks, in person or online

## Spoken for
- CBRE (Global Safety Week), DBFL Consulting Engineers (Safety Week 2026), Summerhill Construction, Cantwell, Coca-Cola Commercial Products Supply, IWEA Health & Safety Conference 2019
